(script
  (command_list
    (command
      (substitute_command
        name: (command_name)
        opening: (delimiter)
        (regular_expression
          (alternation
            (regex_branch
              (anchor
                (character_escape))
              (repetition
                expression: (bracket_expression
                  opening: (bracket_open)
                  (character_class
                    (class_open)
                    (compound_marker)
                    name: (class_name
                      (class_name_text))
                    (compound_marker)
                    (class_close))
                  (range
                    start: (bracket_character
                      (literal))
                    (range_operator)
                    end: (bracket_character
                      (literal)))
                  closing: (bracket_close))
                operator: (regex_operator)))))
        separator: (delimiter)
        (replacement
          (case_conversion)
          (matched_text_reference)
          (case_conversion))
        closing: (delimiter)
        (substitution_flags
          (flag))))
    (command_separator)))

==================
Class before two hyphens at EOF can still become independent — "/[[:alpha:]--"
:language(gsed)
:language(gsed_ere)
:cst
==================
/[[:alpha:]--
------------------
0:0  - 0:13   script
0:0  - 0:13     command_list
0:0  - 0:13       command
0:0  - 0:13         address: address_clause
0:0  - 0:13           address
0:0  - 0:13             regex_address
0:0  - 0:1                opening: delimiter `/`
0:1  - 0:13               regular_expression
0:1  - 0:13                 alternation
0:1  - 0:13                   regex_branch
0:1  - 0:13                     bracket_expression
0:1  - 0:2                        opening: bracket_open `[`
0:2  - 0:13                       range
0:2  - 0:11                         issue: syntax_issue
